pane.readOnlyGlobal: These fees apply to all events and are translated under Fees.

scopeHint.event: Title, subtitle and description of the event and the name and description of the venue (venue texts apply to all events at this venue).
scopeHint.pricing: Names and descriptions of price categories and tariffs.
scopeHint.fees: Fee names as shown in the cart, checkout and e-mails. Global fees apply to all events.
scopeHint.shopPage: Titles and texts of the info boxes on the event page.
scopeHint.waitingRoom: Title and message of the waiting room. Announcements are translated when they are published.
scopeHint.globalFees: Names of global fees as shown in the cart, checkout and e-mails.
scopeHint.globalQueue: Title and message of the global waiting room.

empty.waitingRoom: This event uses the global waiting room settings. Save own waiting room settings for this event to translate them here.
empty.globalQueue: There are no global waiting room settings yet.

notTranslatable: This tab has no translatable texts. Switch the content language back to the default to edit its settings.
